notes: Категория обновления: Глобальное. SkyRealm Launcher 1.2.76 + Game 0.20.50.176: verified account session UI; friends, private chat and co-op room invitations; update center with rollback and repair; custom game install folder; FPS cap, separate music and effects volume, remappable keyboard controls and accessibility settings; F12 screenshots with in-launcher gallery; local game calendar and support center with diagnostics report; multi-service status and local performance monitor; cloud world backups; in-app notifications; 41 built-in mods with gameplay effects; external SkyRealmStudio desktop editor with automatic installed-app detection, one-click official download, SHA-256 verification and launch; in-game script editor removed; direct script-mod publishing from SkyRealm Mod Studio with pre-publication validation and launcher-to-game synchronization; public community mod catalog with account-verified ZIP publishing, archive validation, search, categories, downloads and SHA-256 metadata. World favorites and saved mod profiles; progress statistics for playtime, worlds, level and achievements; VSync low-latency Canvas option; sea expedition with animated ocean waves, detailed ship and sailor, visible sharks and underwater creatures, reefs, islands and shipwrecks; repairs missing marine populations in existing sea saves; robust WASD, arrow keys, physical-key-code navigation across keyboard layouts and on-screen hold-to-sail sea controls; account buttons hidden after server-verified login; friend presence (online, away, do not disturb, in-game); expanded six-stage technology progression with physically placed fuel generators, solar panels, batteries, automated mining drills, ore processors, powered shields, turrets, lamps and settlement walls; scheduled night sieges with real monsters spawned around world rifts, live combat tracking for weapon, magic, pet and turret kills, automatic cleanup and save recovery; ancient guardian awakenings with visible map beacons, directional markers and proximity-based combat; five-room Lost Citadel expedition with persistent room progress and rarity-based relic equipment that boosts player damage and defense; expansion progress is stored in each world save; Boss Realm Awakening adds the Ashen Titan, Ice Empress, Mirror of the Abyss and Worldbreaker Colossus raid, four animated arenas with lava and elemental effects, two repeatable guardian trials, ten passive relics, and new world events; four fixed Boss World arenas route major bosses to their assigned arenas; 12 professions (Lumberjack, Miner, Farmer, Hunter, Fisherman, Builder, Crafter, Blacksmith, Alchemist, Cook, Explorer and Technologist) track real actions automatically, with repeatable contracts, career XP, levels, rewards and resource bonuses; Russian and English in-game language selection; and an expanded ordinary world with a stone quarry, an eight-level underground mine with branching galleries, side passages, support beams, breakable resource barrels and cave creatures, deeper mithril/uranium/diamond deposits, pickaxe upgrades, regrowing veins, compost and fertilizer recipes, stonemason ranks, stone sales and delivery contracts; six new mods add bonuses for forestry, farming, crafting, geology, cooking and power generation; both in-game admin and moderator panels add one-click God armor set, Abyss Blade and maximum gear upgrades, including a persistent leggings slot with real damage mitigation; existing accounts and local worlds remain compatible. Adds a dedicated player voting page with server-backed one-account voting, duplicate idea merging and promotion after three different player submissions; includes the live development roadmap, categorized release history and generated posters for major/global updates; Boss Realm tree chopping can awaken the animated, hostile Awakened Tree with glowing eyes, moving root legs, root-snare attacks and a guaranteed Heartwood Core trophy; ordinary-world forests now contain rare animated fruit-bearing trees that yield forest berries when chopped. Adds the Ancient Forest in Boss Realm with rune-marked ancient trees, mineable crystal and stone deposits, the Forest King raid boss awakened after five chopped ancient trees, multi-phase root-wave combat and summoned forest guardians, a unique Heart of the Ancient Forest relic, the Root Crypt guardian trial, a root trap and a cursed treasure chest. Ordinary worlds now include roaming deer, foxes, boars, owls and hares that can be fed berries for rare gifts; the hidden Whispering Cave guardian encounter and treasure; abandoned settlement ambushes; recurring night bandit raids; seasonal snow, leaves and petals; and persistent tree regrowth after three ordinary-world days or five Boss Realm days. Adds World Chronicles to ordinary worlds with daily resource contracts, six-enemy village defense encounters, five-enemy ancient trail expeditions and persistent rewards; Boss Realm Chronicles track creature kills, ancient tree awakenings, boss and god victories, provide daily trials and allow one daily Rift Warden elite summon. Trade cities now gain a reputation and happiness rank, five civic buildings with real material costs, daily greenhouse supplies and an enemy-spawning defense patrol; the sea adds three discoverable islands with one-time inventory rewards and a three-phase Kraken boss gated by island exploration and ship upgrades. PrimeLauncher now includes a local ELO leaderboard, a clear offline-mode notice directing players to bot training, +10 coins per second during each Prime match; compact island arena surrounded by animated ocean and a sandy shoreline; two towers per side; richer pixel-art fighters and moving capes; enemy unit combat and 12-second bot respawns; collision-aware walls, sprint stamina and rotatable placement previews; minimap, hit numbers, shot tracers and combat feed. Match coins remain temporary and reset at the result screen. Prime buildings now have real five-level progression with escalating upgrade prices, growing health and visibly enhanced structures; barracks capacities are enforced, forge bonuses, infirmary healing and archery training scale by level, and new stable cavalry, siege catapults, area-damage mage towers and coin-generating markets are functional. Bots can invest in cavalry infrastructure. Prime battle systems add three captureable outposts with match income, contested supply convoys that respawn and can be seized by either side, timed weather events (rain, fog and tailwind) that alter ranged damage, three commander abilities with real cooldowns and combat effects (war cry, shield formation and area fire volley), and a neutral mercenary camp that hires up to three fighters per contract subject to barracks capacity, proximity, cost and cooldown. New systems are visible on the minimap and HUD, with outpost flags, supply chests, a mercenary camp, weather overlays and Russian/English labels. The PrimeLauncher Start Center adds three one-click launch destinations, four saved performance profiles, local pre-flight diagnostics, backup history with restore from a selected save point and a safety snapshot before each restore, a persistent session timer and four accent themes. Adds the Adventure Guild with four rotating daily contracts; three multi-wave expeditions (Forgotten Ruins, Frost Pass and Abyss Rift) with weapon-based combat; coordinate-based treasure maps and land-only caches; four upgradable camp buildings with persistent bonuses; six collectible relics that improve guild rewards and expedition damage; and a seasonal token festival with potion and resource exchanges. Guild progress is saved per world, interrupted expeditions recover after loading, and the responsive guild interface is restricted to supported single-player modes. Player walking and movement code remain unchanged. Adds a 30-day branching Guild Mail campaign with four saved decisions and consequence-based letters and finale rewards; expands the guild with a buildable Archive, Trophy Hall, Dormitory and Workshop, a physical announcement board, and residents following the in-game rest/work/social/patrol schedule; adds four persistent rune-order puzzles with different sequences and visual clues to the five-room Ancient Ruins; improves dungeon stonework, animated torch lighting and rune effects. Game 0.20.50.167 fixes the live terrain-rendering path so the classic illustrated tile painter is actually used, restores green grass across the ordinary valley while keeping snow as a separate biome, narrows paths, reduces the player sprite to 84% without touching movement or physics, removes the exterior guild notice board and keeps guild contracts, expeditions, rooms, camp, treasure and relics inside the enterable guild hall; wall collision and the doorway are regression-tested.
